# TCET ACM SIGITE Student Chapter

> Thakur College of Engineering & Technology's premier ACM SIGITE Student Chapter in Mumbai, India.

## Overview
TCET ACM SIGITE is dedicated to empowering IT engineering students through hands-on technical workshops, national hackathons, research innovation, and industry exposure.

- [Home Portal](https://tcet.acm.org/)

- [Visual Archive & Gallery](https://tcet.acm.org/gallery)
